messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty P1 triggered — high error rate on /v1/generate, suspected smart-routing fallback loop. Page routed to oncall Devon. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/RI-9981
Devon: on it. pulling up routing decisions and recent rollouts. which customers are impacted?
Mel: support noticed timeouts for 3 EU enterprise tenants starting ~2026-07-22T10:02Z. error rates ~10-20% for those tenants. ticket #SUP-12345 opened.
Anya: quick summary from logs: lots of "variant_mismatch" entries when requests hit quantized variant gpt-medium-q4. it doesn't support KV cache mode, so sessions with cache enabled fail and then fallback triggers.
Kai: the bigger issue: decision logs don't include route_tags or tenant_id on fallback path. logs show: `route_decision=fallback policy=smart-routing reason=variant_mismatch` but no tag for policy_id/region/variant. can't map back to tenant.
Devon: can we stop the loop quickly? trying a routing policy override: `rictl routing override --policy smart-routing --action disable --reason "fail open loop"`
DeployBot: routing override job queued by Devon. job id: job-4427.
DeployBot: routing override applied successfully (job-4427) — smart-routing disabled for 10m.
IncidentBot: mitigation applied by Devon — smart-routing paused. Traffic now served by pinned regional variants.
Santiago: after override, error rate dropped to baseline within ~90s. still seeing intermittent 503s for sessions that lost KV cache.
Anya: found a related bad rollout: yesterday's model rollout for gpt-medium had `compatible_variants` omitted in the canary config which allowed the quantized variant to be chosen for cache-enabled sessions. that shouldn't happen.
Mel: confirmed impacted customers saw increased latencies and occasional 504s. no data exfiltration. raised priority for customers in EU.
Kai: immediate observability followups: 1) add structured fields to routing decision logs (region, variant, policy_id, attempt_count, tenant_id/route_tags). 2) emit a unique request->decision trace id for correlating logs across services.
Devon: quick short-term fixes applied: 1) pinned traffic for affected tenants to eu-central-1 variant `gpt-medium-v1`. 2) disabled cross-region retries by setting `MAX_ROUTING_RETRIES=2`. 3) enabled debug routing logs for 10m (`ROUTING_DEBUG=1`). note: will significantly increase log volume.
IncidentBot: Warning — Routing debug flag enabled. Expect high log throughput to observability stack.
Santiago: handing off oncall in 25m. summary for next: root cause is rollout + missing compatibility metadata => allowed an incompatible quantized variant to be selected, combined with a policy that retried across regions without proper TTL/attempt caps, leading to a fallback loop. mitigation: policy override + pin region. next actions: patch rollout tooling to require compatible_variants, add decision log fields, and add a policy max-retries TTL.
Devon: adding quick log snippet for the pattern we saw:
```
[10:02:11] request_id=abc123 route_decision=fallback policy=smart-routing reason=variant_mismatch
[10:02:11] request_id=abc123 retry=1 target_region=eu-west-1
[10:02:12] request_id=abc123 route_decision=fallback policy=smart-routing reason=overloaded
[10:02:12] request_id=abc123 retry=2 target_region=eu-central-1
[10:02:13] request_id=abc123 route_decision=fallback policy=smart-routing reason=variant_mismatch
```
Devon: as you can see, without a decision tag we can't tie these to a tenant or model config easily.
Mel: opened post-incident ticket: ENG-4567 to add structured decision logs and require `compatible_variants` in rollout API. also ENG-4568 to add policy-level max-retries and backoff.
Kai: small proposal for log schema (short): `decision_id, request_id, tenant_id, policy_id, variant, region, reason, attempt, timestamp` — can we get triage from infra/observability?
Santiago: I'll loop in eng-infra & eng-ml. @Devon @Anya please drop any config ids and rollout ids here.
Anya: rollout id: rollout-2026-07-gpt-med-03. canary config file reference: `s3://rollouts/gpt-medium/canary-03.json`.
Devon: policy id: smart-routing-v2. Current override: disabled by job-4427 until 2026-07-22T10:12Z. will extend if needed.
PagerDuty: Incident RI-9981 acknowledged by Devon. Severity set to P1.
Mel: support comms: drafting status update to impacted customers, ETA 30m.
Santiago: taking over oncall. next steps while I'm on: 1) confirm rollback or patch for incompatible variant; 2) coordinate logs schema change with infra; 3) monitor customer error rates and remove routing override once fully validated.
Devon: handing off — I'll be available for 2h if you need rapid rollback. good job team. :thumbsup:
IncidentBot: Incident RI-9981 — mitigated (smart-routing paused). Postmortem required.
Mel: tagging postmortem owners: Anya (eng-ml), Devon (eng-platform), Kai (observability). I'll set timeline and impact summary.
Santiago: ack, will start a bridge and calendar invite for postmortem tomorrow.
Devon: leaving thread — thanks.
Santiago: closing pager now, will reopen if we see regression.
